label: Bible Study
note: The shortest verse in the Bible — and one of the most human.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: But my God shall supply all your _____ according to his riches in glory by Christ Jesus.
verse: But my God shall supply all your need according to his riches in glory by Christ Jesus.
note: Supply according to His riches, not according to your budget. The exchange rate is generous.

label: Sunday School
prompt: Neither is there _____ in any other: for there is none other name under heaven given among men, whereby we must be saved.
verse: Neither is there salvation in any other: for there is none other name under heaven given among men, whereby we must be saved.
note: Peter before the council: one name under heaven, no backup options listed.

label: Deep Water
prompt: Behold, the days come, saith the Lord GOD, that I will send a _____ in the land, not a famine of bread, nor a thirst for water, but of hearing the words of the LORD:
verse: Behold, the days come, saith the Lord GOD, that I will send a famine in the land, not a famine of bread, nor a thirst for water, but of hearing the words of the LORD:
note: Amos's most haunting judgment: not empty stomachs, but silence from heaven.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Who gave himself for us, that he might redeem us from all iniquity, and purify unto himself a _____ people, zealous of good works.
verse: Who gave himself for us, that he might redeem us from all iniquity, and purify unto himself a peculiar people, zealous of good works.
note: 'Peculiar' meant 'his own treasured possession,' not 'odd' — though the church manages both.
